abstract.t: The Gravit Epistemic Verification Protocol (GEVP) defines how signed evidence Records about an Artifact are screened, grouped by independent source and evaluated, so that a claim is never promoted beyond what independent evidence supports. It specifies the Epistemic State Machine, the Record format and its signature, the meaning of the signed result of a Record, a verifier registry accepted under a threshold of root keys, a content-addressed Decision Record that anyone can reproduce, and optional signed receipts that let an auditor check a history of decisions offline. It maps these states to the evidence taxonomy of the Gravit Verifiable Epistemic Decision Standard (VEDS).
